༄༅/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal gdams gud du sbas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal gdams gud du sbas pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig yang zlog me'i spu gri la yi dam du bya ba dag gis las sbyor srung zlog bsad pa'i snga rol du bsnyen bsgrub bya ba shin tu gal che ba'i phyir/ de dag gi tshul zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rtsa rgyud dang zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud sogs nas gsungs pa rnams legs par mthong zhing rtogs pas/ de dag gi man ngag lag len rnams go bde bar bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas de dag gi bsnyen bsgrub bya bar 'dod na/ sbyor ba'i chos dang*/ gshin rje nag po'i sngags rgyud kyi sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid dang nyams su blang ba'i go rim bstan pa'i le'u brgyad pa las/ rigs yod sdom dang ldan zhing dbang thob man ngag mnos// rgyud thos dam tshig bsrung zhing snying rje che dang bdun// de bdun ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// 'di nyid nyams su blang bar bya| |zhes gsungs pas/ mtshan nyid bdun po ldan pa'i sngags pas sgrub cing*/ gzhan byung rgyal gang rung gis sgrub par ma gsungs so// dngos gzhi gnyis so// dang po sbyor ba'i chos ni yid mthun pa'i gnas su/ 'bum 'don/ sāts+tsha gdab/ bskang bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi la blo sbyang*/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bsgom| rnam par mi rtog pa'i don dran par bya/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ngag 'don gyi srung ba'i dus rtsibs nang du bskyed pa ltar rang nyid bsgoms pa'i thugs kar muṃ dmar ser la sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes pa drug 'bum bzla zhing 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rtag tu 'don par dam bca' ba sogs mdor na bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa grub tshad la nan tan du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos wā gī shwa ra drug 'bum sngon du bzla dgos pa ni/

zla gsang rtsa rgyud chen po'i le'u bcu dgu par/ ye shes sems dpa' bsgoms byas nas// wā gī shwa ra drug 'bum 'don// zhes gsungs/ yang gsang sngags lnga thams cad 'khrul 'khor rgya bsdebs pa'i rgyud las/ wā gī shwa ra muṃ/ thugs kar muṃ las bskyed byas nas// 'phro 'du dang bcas 'bum tsho gcig /sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen pa ste// zhes gsungs pas/ rab 'bum tsho drug /de ma byung na 'bum phrag gcig gis kyang chog par gsungs so// zhi bsnyen 'di bya tshul rgyas pa logs su yod pa de bzhin du rdzogs par grub rjes/ gzhi bsnyen dngos la 'jug dgos kyi 'dir zhi bsnyen sa bcad tsam las ma bris so// gzhi la bzhi/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor sngags rgyud nag po'i rtogs pa bcu gnyis par/ bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang*// sgrub pa dang ni sgrub chen po// dgos pa'i don chen gang la'ang*// bsnyen pa dngos grub rnam gsum thob// de ma yin pas dngos mi 'grub// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ lha bsnyen pa/ nye bar bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa chen po/ 'chi bdag bdud sgrub rnams so// dang po lha bsnyen pa ni/ zla ba tha chung bzhi'i yar ngo'i grub pa'i nyi ma gang yin la bab pa'i tshe/ gshin rje nag po sngags rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa las/ zla ba yar ngo'i gza' gang bzang*// mda' 'phen pa yi zla ba'i dus// zhes dgun zla tha chung gi yar ngo la'ang sgrub par gsungs la/ mda' 'phen pa'i zla ba ni/ dgun tha ma yin pa rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud nas gsungs shing*/ dgun zla ni hor zla bcu gcig pa la byed na rgya nag rnying ma bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dgongs pa rnam par dag pa'o// gshin rje ma ru rtse'i sngags rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa las/ sngags pas mda' 'phen zla ba ni// nyi ma rlung bar dbang nas ni// smin drug sa 'og ma song bar du bya// zhes hor zla bcu gcig pa nas bzung nas smin drug rol 'og la ma song gi bar de rnams gang 'dzoms la bya dgos pa yin no// dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su/ bsnyen pa'i gnas ni/

gshin rje'i gshed nag po las thams cad grub par byed pa 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ chu 'gram chen po bas mtha' dang*// dur khrod shing drung dgon pa ste// dben sa yul dang ma mo'i khyim// der ni mgon po de la 'bad// gzhan du bsgrubs kyang de mi 'grub// ces gsungs shing*/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang por yang*/ de la gnas gsungs pa ni/ dur khrod dam/ chu klung gi 'gram mam/ shing gcig gi mtshan ma gcig pa'am/ bzhi mdo 'am/ ri'am/ rtse mo'am/ khang stong ngam/ ma mo'i khyim mam/ lha'i khang pa'am/ 'thab mo'i gnas sam/ grong khyer ram/ nags khrod dam/ grong bar la sogs pa'i gnas su sngags gnas te/ zhes gsungs pas/ gnas 'di rnams gang rung du bya'o// maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma dris byugs pa'i steng du sman raka gtor ma/ rus sbal khog pa sogs su mchod gtor bshams la mtshams grol khar sgrub khang steng du 'bul/ rtags gtor gcig zur du bshams la rtags nam byung thog steng du 'bul zhing phul phral slar gsar pa bcos pa bzhag nas rtags byung rim gyi rtags gtor re re 'bul lo// mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ mdun du 'jam dpal 'jam dpal gshin rje khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u las/ dur khrod ras la dpa' bo'i gzugs// mtshon rtsi spyin med bzang po yi// khros pa'i gzugs la sprin nag mdog |mkhas pas yab yum sras bcas bri// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bya// zhes pa ltar/ bris sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gal che'o// gshin rje'i bris sku bkram/ phyi nang gi mtshams dam par bcad// phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag bgegs la so sor gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo/ ku sha la sogs pa'i stan bde bar 'dug la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sngags rgyud 'khrul 'khor nag po'i le'u lnga pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i skabs las/ dri spos sman dang bdud rtsi'i chu// 'bar ba'i sngags kyis lus bkrus shing*// bdud rtsi 'khyil pas rab tu bstod// lho yi phyogs su kha bltas la// zhes gsungs pas/

las gshin dang 'khyil pa bzlas pa'i dri'i chus khrus byas nas/ nges par kha lho phyogs su phyogs pas bsnyen sgrub la 'jug go// skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs skyabs sems dang*/ ma rig rgyu sogs snying rje rnam gsum| dka' thub drag pos sdom pa dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar la/ sbas lha gnyis yod med rang gang mos byas pas chog cing gang ltar na'ang bskyed rim gsal bar bya/ mchod pa'i skabs bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i phyag rgya bzhi las mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi spros nas/ phyi nang gsang ba sman raka gtor tshogs kyi mchod par bsam zhing bstod pa sogs bya/ de nas bsnyen pa la 'jug pa ni/ mgo bo rma bya bzhin du dgug /ru rak+sha yi phreng ba bgrang*/ bsnyen pa'i gong nas bgrang phreng rab gnas tshul bzhin du byas nas ma nyams par dgos shing*/ thun so so'i 'gor yang phreng ba byin rlabs kyi sngags nyer gcig tsam re bzla ba gal che'o// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun par/ de nas gzhan yang bzlas pa yi// cho ga ji skad gsungs pa bshad// ri mo bkram nas mchod byas te// de bzhin gshegs pa kun mchod nas// ku sha'i stan la 'dug nas ni// mnyam par bzhag ste mi smra bar// ri mo gcig po la bltas shing*// mgo ni rma bya bzhin bkug ste// ru rak+sha yi phreng ba ni// ji srid yid ni mi skyo'i bar// rtse gcig sems kyis bzlas byas te// skyo na bzlas pa gtang bar bya// zhes sogs don gcig po 'di nyid rgyud mang por yang yang bldabs nas gsungs 'dug pas gal chen po nyid du rigs par bya'o// mgon po nyid la gus byas te// dmigs pa ni/ zhes pa zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi pa dang*/

zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi skabs brgyad par gsungs so| |'di 'dra'i rigs kyi bsnyen sgrub bzhi gar rgyud kyi tshig rnams bris na yig tshogs che bar 'jigs nas don rnams bsdus te bris pa yin no// phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs su ma gyur pa gang yang med pa til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba/ bdag dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba'i tsit+ta gzhal yas khang gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su pad+ma zla nyi'i steng du rang rig ye shes kyi ngo bo gdod nas yongs su grub pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang pa/ sku mdog dmar ser/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dpung pa'i thad du gdengs shing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pala'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba rgyas pa'i steng du stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan can/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyis bklubs pa/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can zhi zhing 'dzum mdangs can| de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla nyi'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ lha gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar yang de 'dra ba re re gsal zhing*/ bdag gis sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/ thugs ka nas sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du 'phros/ ljags steng brgyud de phyir 'dom gang tsam phyin pa'i tshe sngags 'bru 'od dang bcas pa rnams kyang lha'i sku phra mo grangs med par gyur nas de rnams kyi zhal nas kyang sngags bzla zhing 'od zer rnams mchod pa'i lha dang lha mor gyur/

phar 'phros 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa rnams phul/ 'od zer de dag bdag la tshur 'dus pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te bdag nyid la thim par bsam pa'i ngang nas/ rdo rje zla nyi sa bon rnams mi 'gul bar sngags phreng g.yas su drag la myur bar dus rtag tu 'khor bar dmigs pa gal che'o// oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa ni yi ge bcu bdun pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ| ces pa'i yi ge bcu gcig pa rnying rgyud pra khog slang gi rtags zhes dang*/ gsar rgyud du 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo zhes rgyud gcig la mtshan gsar rnying so sor btags pa de sngags de'i mthu nus phan yon gsungs pa rnams zur du bris yod do// dang*/ ya ma me dak+ṣe rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni/ zhes pa'i ya ma bcu bdun pa ste/ sngags gsum po gang yang rung ba/ sngags gsum po gang rung gis chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'jam dpal khro bo rin chen gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u las/ lha srin srog gi rtsa ba yin// yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba ste// rnal ma'i yi ge ngo bo lta// rang bzhin stong pa nus pa'i me// nyi zla rgya mtsho lhun por brjod// ya mān+ta ka'i ngo bo nyid// oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i rme rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa sngags kyi le'u las/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang las sngags dang*// dmod pa'i sngags dang bsad sngags dang*// ma lus 'di nyid yin pa ru// dam tshig bdag pos rab tu gsungs// oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭ/ bye ba sngon du 'gro bar rigs// ri rab rdul du rlog pa dang*// rgya mtsho dag kyang skem par nus// gnam lcags ser ba 'bebs pa dang*// zlog pa dag kyang thogs pa med// khros na bdud kyang brlag byed la// bltas pa tsam gyis dgra yang tungs// dga' na sems can gso ba dang*// 'khor ba dong nas sprug par nus// sngags kyi don gnyis lha yin te// lha yi rang bzhin sngags nyid do// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

'jam dpal khro bo rin po che gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa'i rtsa ba'i le'u las/ 'jam dpal nang nas 'jam dpal nyid// ces sogs nas/ dus kyi bsnyen pa gtso ru blang*// zhes pa'i bar gsungs shing*/ gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi sngags kyi tshad ma'i le'u las/ rtsa ba nyid ltar grang ba ni// a kro yig 'bru bcu bdun yin// zhes dang de nyid las/ sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen pa ni// a kro bcu bdun rgyun du bgrang*| |zhes sogs gsungs so// gzhan yang 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum par/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'di ni khro bo'i rgyal po gang gi rtogs pa 'di yin pa de'i sngags yig tu yig 'bru bcu bdun pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ rgyud de nyid kyi le'u drug par/ khro bo yi ni gtso bo yi// yi ge bcu bdun sngags bzla'o// oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'di ni rtsa ba'i yig 'bru bcu bdun pa'o// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyi le'u bdun par/ bzlas pa'i grangs ni nges par dag /cho ga zhib mo 'dir bshad bya// thog mar 'bum drug bzlas pa ni// sngon du bsnyen pa byas par gyur// de nas bu don cho ga yi// phyis kyang drug 'bum bzla bar bya// de bzhin ri rtser 'bum bzlas na// 'grub par 'gyur te gzhan du min// zhes rgyud 'dir 'bum tsho bcu gsum bzla dgos par gsungs 'dug pa ni gong du bshad pa las 'bum phrag gnyis lhag 'dug pa'ang bris pa yin no// yang na/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i rme rgyud kyi yi ge 'khor lo rdzogs chen gyi le'u las/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ khro rgyal rngam pa'i rgyal po nyid// bdag dang dbyer med rdzogs pa'i sku// zhes pa nas/ brtan pa der gnas dngos grub blang*| |zhes pa'i bar rgyas par gsungs so// yang na gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi srog la drangs pa'i le'u las/

srog snying rnam pa bzhir bstan pa// 'dir ni 'khor lo 'chi bdag srog /ya ma me dak+ṣe rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni/ srog snying nyi ma shar ltas 'byung*// zhes pa nas/ bya rgod gzan la bcum bzhin 'byung*// zhes pa'i bar gsungs shing*/ gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi sngags kyi tshad ma'i le'u las/ bya rgod gzan bcum drang ba ni// ya ma yi ge bcu bdun yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sngags gsum po gang rung re re la grangs tshad thems na nges par chog go// mi tshig gis bar ma chod cing mi tshig gis bar ma chod par dgos pa ni/ zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu gsum pa las/ rnal 'byor nang la gtam zer na// lag gi brda yis brda bar bya// skom dang za bar 'dod pa'i tshe// lag gi brda yis blang bar bya// smras na rnal 'byor rang don zad// de yi phyir na lag brda bya// zhes gsungs so// zla gsang man ngag gi rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig par/ mi tshig bar ma chod par bya// bar du chad na don mi 'grub// ces mi tshig gis bar chad na mi 'grub par gsungs so// lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas 'bum phrag drug 'bad rtsol gyis bzla dgos shing*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor nag po'i sngags rgyud kyi rtogs pa bcu gnyis par/ bsnyen pa'i sngon du lha bkug la// las kyi ya ma dbang du bsdu// de yis lha dang las byed 'gugs// rtags la rnam pa gsum du 'dod// phyi nang gsang ba nye bar bzung*// mgo la sku gdung nyi zla dgab// bdud rtsi chu la khrus byed dang*// me chu 'tshub ma 'khyil ba dang*// klu la 'dod phyir gru rdzings bskyod// glang chen zhon nas mtshon cha 'bar| |gcan gzan bdag rgod bsrun pa las// phyi yi rtags te spyod yul 'gyur// dam rdzas gsar te mchod pa 'bul// gtor ma bran la sman raka brlabs// mtshan ma gsum gyi dgug par bya// zhes gsungs so// sngags kyi bzla tshul ni/

'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u las/ myur ba ma yin bul ma yin// de bzhin yi ge 'dres pa min// shin tu gsal phyir dag par smra// sngags kyi bzlas grangs bar bar du// khro bo'i bstod sgra gtang bar bya// rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'bul// zhes dang*/ gshin rje nag po'i sngags rgyud nag po bsnyen pa'i le'u las/ mi smra glal sbrid gnyid rmugs dang*// sgra chen sgra chung spangs pa dang*// drag la ring thung rdzogs pa dang*// yid la shi phur bzlas pa'i thabs// zhes gsungs pa ltar| skyon rnams dang bral zhing mtshan nyid tshang bar bzla dgos so// de'ang mtshams bcad pa'i nub dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sngags brgya skor zhig 'bul/ de nas sman mchod byas nas ngal gso zhing nyal| phyi nangs nas gong ltar gsal ba gsum ldan gyi ngang nas bzlas pa la 'bad/ thun yang lcogs na drug dang ma lcogs na/ nyi shar/ nyin gung*/ nyi nub/ nam srod de thun bzhir bcad pa'i thun bar du gtor ma gsos la sman zla gsang 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u drug cu pa las kyi spyir bstan pa'i skabs su/ dus drug dag tu pū dza 'bul// zhes gsungs pa yin no// raka bsgron nas gtor bsngos rgyas par byas pa'i mthar mchod sbyin thabs mchog bde chen mas bstod do// 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa las sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u las/ sngags kyi phreng ba stong rdzogs dang*// stong tshogs mchod dang bstod pa bya// drag tu gshin rje dgug pa ni// khur bas bus la gshin mi bzlog /tshil chen mar me rgyun mi 'chad// rdza rnga rdung zhing bshug pas 'bod// smug chen smug chung snying smug chen smug chung zhes pa mi rta'i snying yin pa kha thun nas gsungs/ byung na gri snying dgos/ ma byung na shi snying dgos snying gnyis po spyan gzigs su nges par tshang dgos so// la 'bod// dpa' bo grub rtags byung ba na// dngos grub dam zhing blang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

tshil chen gyi mar me/ sha chen dang gu gul bsres pa'i bdug pa dang*/ rdza rnga'i rol mo sogs bya ba gnad che'o/ gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud rwa snga 'gyur las/ gzhan du mi 'gro sems kyis ni// de lta'i tshul du bzla bar bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba ni| |bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin// mi 'phro sems kyis 'di zlos shig /zhes gsungs pas/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe 'di gzhan du mi yeng bar dmigs pa kho na la yid gtod par gal che'o// de ltar ma yeng bar bzla ba ni bsnyen pa bya ba'i rim pa'o// de dag zin nas gnyis pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi yi ge 'khor lo rdzogs chen gyi le'u las/ sgo lnga rang sor yul med bzhag /be shing 'khar ba thogs nas ni| |bying nas rmugs par gyur pas na// 'jam dbyangs khro bo 'dzab kyis bskul// g.yel zhing rgod par gyur pas na// mtshan ma lha yi sku la blta// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ 'di'i sgrub ma grol bar bying na 'dzab dbyangs bya zhing dal gyis bcag /rgod na bris sku sogs la blta zhing bying rgod sogs kyi skyon gang yang med par dus kun tu bsgrims nas bzla bar bshad pa ltar bya'o// bca' gzhi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'jam dpal zhi khro'i sku gnyis bris 'bur gang rung zhig nges par bsham dgos par gsungs 'dug go// gong ma ltar la dmigs pa sogs kyang snga ma kho na ltar gyi sngags 'bum phrag gsum bzla ba ni nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o// de ltar nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i bsnyen pa bgyis pa'i tshe bris sku zhal 'dzum pa dang dngos nyams rmi lam sogs su lha dang mjal ba rtags/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'khrul 'khor nag po'i sngags rgyud kyi rtags pa bcu gnyis par/ 'od sgra du ba bzhad cing ston| |dmag 'dren drag 'gugs dbang byed dang*// nags gcod bka' 'bebs las chud dang*// gcod yul rnam gsum nang du bzung*// bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags rgyud rnams nas gsungs pa rnams zur du phyung nas bris yod pas der rtogs par byos shig

|bzang po mthong nas/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa las/ yab yum sngags kyi grangs thems kyang*// lha yi mtshan ma ma mthong na// sngags kyi dam tshig nyams srid pas// lhu dum bsil la brgya bshags bya// de tshe mtshan rtags mngon du ster// des kyang rtags rnams ma byung na// gsang sngags sil bur lho nas zlog /ru khug ru nyal ru nyam dang*// ru zlog drag po gnad la dbab// bzhug la dam tshig brdar la bzhag /lha nyid gnad la dbab pa ste// kun gyi bya ba ma yin te// las rnams gdugs na bya ba yin// mi 'grub 'grub par bya ba ru// dam tshig bdag pos rab tu gsungs// zhes pa ltar/ bsnyen pa thems kyang rtags ma byung na bshags pa dang sngags bsdebs sogs man ngag ltar bya dgos so// gsum pa sgrub pa chen po la 'jug pa ni/ bca' gzhi snga ma ltar la dngos grub kyi rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'khrul 'khor nag po'i gsang rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su/ phyi nang gsang ba drod rnyed nas// dngos grub rdzas la brten nas blang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma dang*/ sbrang rtsi/ chos sman sbyar ba'i rdzas rnams bkod la mchod gtor sogs snga ma bas ches cher bzang ba bshams dgos so// bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs rje dang nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas bris sku dang dngos grub kyi rdzas la thim par dmigs shing*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud dang tshe srog phun tshogs thams cad 'od kyis bsdus nas dngos grub kyi rdzas bstim dmigs pa bya'o// gong gi sngags 'bum phrag gcig glal dang sbrid pa dang brkyang bskum dang gnyid sogs le lo spangs nas shin tu bsgrims la bzla/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'khrul 'khor nag po'i sngags rgyud kyi rtogs pa bcu gnyis par/

lus yang sems rgod lung pa yangs// zas dang skom gyi 'du shes chung*// nyon mongs shes pa yul la 'bar// snga na med pa'i rnam pa myong*// thun zor sha khrag rngams shing rol// gsang ba'i rtags de dbang sdud sbyar// sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi dran pas bzung*// thod pa bdud rtsi ril bu brten// dkar dmar dar dang ru spos rgyas// btab pa dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag /brgyad nas nya'i bar dag tu// dngos grub dbang gi cho ga bya// rnal 'byor 'dod pa blang bar bya// lha sgom mtshams bcad sid+dhi dbab// 'od sgra dri rlangs dri dang skur// mthong na phyag rgya gnas lngar btab// dngos grub blangs la sbyor ba brtsam// zhes gsungs pas/ dngos grub kyi sgrub pa 'di tshes brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar gsungs 'dug go// thun mtshams rnams su gtor 'bul dang*/ mchod bstod/ tshogs mchod sogs rgyas par bya/ sngags 'bum phrag thems ma thag dngos grub kyi rdzas gzhan la mi ster bar rang nyid kyis longs spyod do// tshul de lta bu brtson 'grus drag po bgyis na bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub bo// bzhi pa 'chi bdag bdud dang gshin rje'i bsnyen pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i gnas su rang nyid kha lhor bltas/ bca' gzhi sogs sngar ltar lha sgrub bdud sgrub 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'khrul 'khor nag po'i gsang rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su/ las kyi gshin rje las la bsnyen// khro bo bka' thub ldan pa yis// sna tshogs me rlung 'khor lo can// 'bum phrag bkug la ya sogs bzla// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// byas la/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ mthing nag gnas 'gyur ba yi ge ya nag po me 'od 'bar ba lta bu'i mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe de rnams las 'od zer drag po phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa 'jig rten khams kyi dregs byed thams cad la phog pas/

de thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas/ rang dbang med par bdag gi mdun du skad cig la bkug pas/ bdag nyid kyi bka' nyan gsung sdod par bsam la yid ma yeng bar sngags gong ma 'bum phrag gcig drag tu bzla'o// thun mtshams rnams su dregs pa rnams la gtor ma 'bul| des ni dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro// de ltar bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad bsdoms te bstan pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags dang mjug gi las bstan pa ni/ zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi skabs brgyad pa las/ bye ba chig 'bum thon pa dang*// me tog la sogs mchod par bya// phyi nang gi ni mchod pas mchod// bstod pa la sogs ci rigs bya// bsnyen pa rdzogs nas rtags rnams 'byung*// 'jam dpal sku ni zhal 'dzum mam// rtags ni bzang po byung ba dang*// dngos grub la sogs blang bar bya// de nas drag po'i sbyor la 'jug /ces gsungs pas/ 'di'i bsnyen pa la grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gcig dang 'bum phrag gcig /dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig /rtags kyi bsnyen pa 'jam dpal zhal 'dzum pa sogs te/ gshin rje nag po rngam rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa las/ dus kyi bsnyen sgrub zla ba gcig gsungs pa ni/ bshad tshod tsam yin gyi nang rtags nges shes 'drongs pa zhig ma byung bar du 'bad dgos so// mthong dang thos dang rmi lam gsum// bsnyen pa'i rtags su shes par bya// zhes rab zhal mthong ba/ 'bring lung bstan thob pa/ tha ma rmi lam du rtogs pa dgos/ rmis ltas bshad tshod dang mthun pa byung na rab/ phyed tsam byung na 'bring*/ 'ga' zung la cha 'grig tsam byung na nyan tsam yin no// de ltar grangs dus rtags gsum gyi sgo nas bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub chen 'chi bdag bdud sgrub rnams bag yod brtson ldan gyis bsgrubs phyin gshin rje'i gshed kyi phrin las gang sgrub kyang myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar bsnyen sgrub bzhi po thems nas tshogs 'khor dang*/

bskang bshags dang*/ gtor 'bul sogs gtang rag gi mchod pa rgyas pa bya/ grub na bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po rnams kyang tshar bcu re'am/ lnga re'am/ gsum re sogs gang 'grub bya dgos so// dgu gsum sogs la tshogs dang gtor mchod la 'bad cing rgyun gyi bsnyen pa ma chad par bya dgos pa skabs bstun gyi las sbyor rnams gang dgos nyams su blang bas 'bad med du 'grub par 'gyur ro// rnal 'byor rgyun gyi bsnyen pa a kro te ka la byed dgos pa ni/ zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud kyi le'u nyer gsum pa las/ a kro te ka rgyun gyi sngags// de dag sgrub pa'i dus su yang*// mi lus phra men mgo can rab// sprul dang bran g.yog pha ma dang*// mchod rten chen po ston pa dang*// me chen rtag tu 'bar ba dang*// rgya mtsho dag tu mi nub dang*// de dag ma byung bar du bsgrang*// zhes rgyun bsnyen a kro te ka byas pas 'phral du rtags de rnams 'byung bar gsungs so// rtags de rnams ni rgyun bsnyen gyi rtags yin no// zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rtsa rgyud le'u sum cu par yang tshig 'di kho na gsungs 'dug go// rgyun sngags a kro bcu bdun pa'am bcu gcig pa la byed pa ni zla gsang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud kyi le'u brgyad par/ bco brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa// rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'ang a kro gnyis kyi ya ma an+ta ka zhes mtshams ma sbyar bas tsheg bar re re bcu bdun pa la bco brgyad pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa la bcu gnyis pa zhes so// tshul 'di ni deng sang kha cig bsnyen sgrub ma thems par las sbyor gyi sgrub pa la zhugs pas gzhan phung bdag brlag byed pa mang du mthong bas dad brtson dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i phyir/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas|

zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po'i le'u bcu dgu pa dang*/ nyer bzhi pa dang*/ nyer lnga pa dang*/ nyer drug pa dang*/ nyer bdun pa dang*/ nyer brgyad pa rnams dang*/ zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa dang*/ nyer bdun pa dang*/ zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud kyi skabs brgyad pa dang*/ skabs bcu gsum pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bco lnga pa dang*/ bcu drug pa dang*/ bcu bdun pa rnams nas nor 'khrul med cing 'jug pa bde bar/ lcags rta zla ba dgu pa'i tshes drug la pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi 'dun sa'i re'u mig pad+ma 'od du bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /rab 'byams rgyud sde gdengs can 'bum phrag dbus// mthu stobs dbang phyug zla gsang klu dbang gi// snying bcud rin chen dbang gi rgyal po 'di// blo can ded dpon nga min gzhan sus rnyed// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
